bindings_patch_style_constraints: Treat `null_blk` private headers and blk-mq/configfs internals as abstraction-first surfaces rather than bindgen-first surfaces.
Keep the calibration workflow anchored on the in-tree Rust block/configfs abstractions before any blind-first block-driver experiment.

driver_generation_rules: Treat `rnull` as a calibration target first: the plan should validate the official Rust implementation and the tool contracts before any blind-first block-driver run.
Keep request submission/completion, tag-set lifetime, configfs registration, and configfs child lifetime inside the approved block/configfs abstractions only.
Do not model `null_blk` module parameters, fault injection, timers, queue_rqs, or memory-backed/zoned behaviors as if they were already covered by the calibration subset.

driver_side_rules: Do not use `unsafe` in driver code, including `unsafe impl`, `unsafe fn`, or `unsafe {}` blocks.
Do not reference `bindings::*` directly from driver code; keep blk-mq and configfs interaction inside the approved abstractions.
Do not hand-roll request completion, configfs registration, or gendisk/tag-set lifetime management in `{driver_rust_path}`.
Keep the calibration subset restricted to queue/completion plus configfs create/power/configure/destroy behavior until a newer artifact explicitly broadens the scope.
